scope: Public v0.2.1 distribution: anonymous curl updates, scoped provider operations, ownership-safe configuration and compensated uninstall, Apache-2.0 licensing and concise documentation. Preserve session behavior; feature DISTRIBUTION, change PUBLIC-001.

acceptance.description: Preserve strict input/freshness/idle/user budget and cancellation contracts.
Preserve idempotent reversible setup and unrelated configuration ownership.
Preserve native unsupported forwarding and model/permission semantics through packaged execution.
Preserve actual source identities, unchanged personal globals, raw evidence and owned cleanup.
Real relocated macOS arm64 binary works without external Node/npm/Bun or checkout; runtime/addon/helper/assets/licenses and version are bundled and fingerprinted.
Install/status/uninstall use owned stable paths, discover available providers, reject explicit missing providers/conflicts, migrate earlier owned setup and preserve options/global instructions.

Newer install and update/--update synchronize existing owned integrations using verified stable release assets; HTTP, version/platform/digest/download faults leave prior usable state, compensating rollback is verified and concurrent writes fail safely.

Built CLI installs native Claude and Codex fixtures that pass original rollover and literal-marker nonce/K/nonce/permission/cleanup oracles under sanitized PATH, including real strict >100k Claude gate.
One production version binds package/plugin/catalog/tag; tested production binary has source/platform/hash/license receipt and is ready for public root publication; fixture artifacts are distinct.
Explicit provider targets preserve unselected inventory; reject owned path relocation before writes; preflight and compensate uninstall; preserve customized configuration after warm refresh.
